Name: Riruru Furniture Book Lover Collection(CP)
Author: riruru57
Description:
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][color=#93c47d][CP]Riruru Cozy Cttage Core Furniture Book Lover Collection[/color][/size][/font]

[/center]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][color=#b6d7a8]Hello! My new furniture set is finally complete.[/color][/size][/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][color=#b6d7a8]Whenever I play any game, I always create a space surrounded by bookshelves.[/color][/size][/font][/left]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][color=#b6d7a8]I made this furniture set so that others who feel the same way can enjoy it too♡[/color][/size][/font][/left]
[center][/center]
[left][list]
*⌒*⌒*⌒*⌒*⌒*⌒*⌒*⌒*⌒*⌒*⌒ [/list][font=Arial][size=4]Installation and Usage[/size][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Arial]You’ll need to download the latest versions of [b]SMAPI[/b] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]Download this mod and extract it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]To obtain the furniture in-game : use either the [b]Furniture Catalogue[/b] or  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner [/url].[/font][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Arial]Not required, but recommended mods[/font][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Arial] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]﻿Happy Home Designer[/url]  These make it easier to search for and place furniture.( If you search for [b]ccf[/b] in the catalogue, all furniture items will be displayed. )[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url] They also allow you to move furniture pixel by pixel.[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Arial][color=#d9ead3][size=4]About the benches and decorations [/size][/color][/font]
[color=#efefef][font=Arial]The benches in this furniture set are divided into left, center, and right parts.[/font][/color]
[color=#efefef][font=Arial]Although they are named benches, they are categorized as tables, so you cannot sit on them. Instead, you can place different decorations on each part![/font][/color]
[color=#efefef][font=Arial]The many cushions are rotatable, so you can choose your favorite design for either the left or right side.[/font][/color]
[font=Arial][color=#efefef]I also prepared several other decorative items, so please try decorating with your favorite combinations♡ [/color][/font]
[size=3][font=Arial]
The windows are not functional and are purely decorative.
Maybe someday I’ll add windows that actually function as windows… [/font][/size][/left]


[color=#f6b26b][size=4]About the AT version[/size][/color]
This time, I ended up making a lot of furniture in sizes that don’t exist in the vanilla version,so an AT version will not be implemented. I’m sorry.



Other mods used in the screenshots
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25223](CP) Orangeblossom's Basic Wallpaper and Flooring

[/url]
I’m still a beginner when it comes to modding, so I’d really appreciate it if you could let me know about any issues or bugs you encounter.
